query: Publish this finished content deliverable as a new Confluence page in space ID 111 under parent page ID 222, then give me its durable URL.
expected_behavior: Uses the dedicated confluence-publish capability instead of changing the read-only confluence skill
Creates the page only under the explicitly supplied space ID 111 and parent page ID 222
Passes the completed content from its existing file without placing the deliverable in temporary storage
Returns the created page ID, version, title, and durable Confluence URL
